commit_message: Implement and fix ADR 0138 unified Graph Debug
pr_title: GameEngine: implement ADR 0138 unified Graph Debug
pr_body:
## Summary

- reapply ADR 0138 unified Graph Debug on current main, preserving integrated ADR0135 changes
- provide target-aware Behavior Tree and Animation Graph runtime debugging from actual Play evidence
- preserve stable source mappings, resolved Animation Set motion evidence, working-copy precedence, stale suppression, and read-only Graph Canvas overlays
- fix working-copy ownership by round-tripping Graph and GraphView through their existing serialization contracts instead of assuming Clone

## Validation

Run affected Windows Validation and required Editor visual validation.
